blockers: unresolved:verify-01:The editor added this sentence in answer to fan-03, but no opened source supports the order it asserts, and the record points the other way. IndieWire (S15, 2024-09-27, reopened) says 'when he first received the script for Wolfs, Abrams knew only that Clooney and Pitt were set to star' and quotes him: 'All I got was the interrogation scene.' The article itself quotes the first half of that answer in 'How he says yes'. Collider's question (S18, 2024-10-01) asked whether the underwear intimidated him 'while reading the script, especially since you knew you were going to work with these two major movie stars', which places the reading after he was cast. The Italian Reve (S07), cited in C124, describes reading the Weapons script, not Wolfs. The sentence credits him with knowingly choosing the Wolfs exposure, the overstatement fan-03 asked the editor to remove, so fan-03's test ('notes that... he signed onto Wolfs knowing little') is not met.
